answer: Make every new agent post a refundable collateral bond before it can transact, priced so a lone honest node recovers it but a swarm cannot afford one per fake identity. Each bond is a jade token locked for many epochs; genuine peers attest it and build a reputation bridge that outsiders must cross to earn trust. A sybil flooding cheap clones falls into a widening cost canyon as its forfeited bonds vest to the treasury, so faking identities bleeds capital faster than any gain.
